## What changed?

Describe the change concisely.

## Why?

Explain the product or technical reason.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant formatter run
- [ ] Relevant static analysis/lint run
- [ ] Relevant tests run
- [ ] Diff manually reviewed
- [ ] No secrets or signing files added

List commands/results:

```text
NOT RUN / PASS / FAIL
```

## Product / UI

- [ ] Loading/error/empty states handled where applicable
- [ ] No gradients introduced
- [ ] No arbitrary design values introduced
- [ ] No fake functionality or fake production data

## Security / Privacy

- [ ] No new sensitive permission without justification
- [ ] No payment-provider secret exposed to a client
- [ ] Privacy/data-map impact reviewed

## Documentation

- [ ] Relevant docs updated
- [ ] `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md` updated if project state changed
- [ ] ADR added/updated if a durable architecture decision changed
